title: Traffic Sign Detection Using Deep Learning and Classical Computer Vision
description: Real-time traffic sign detection and recognition system benchmarked on the German Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark (GTSDB). The project evaluates a classical computer vision pipeline (HSV thresholding, morphological operations, contour analysis) alongside fine-tuned deep learning models (YOLOv8n and YOLOv8s) for both 4-macro and 43-fine-grained traffic sign classification, achieving up to 89.2% mAP@0.5 with high real-time inference throughput (>140 FPS).
